title: Application Pipeline Session State v1.0.0
description: Accumulates user-approved decisions and gap-filling answers across pipeline stages. Written incrementally — each stage appends its outputs. Downstream stages read from this file rather than scraping conversation history.

stage4_gap_answers.description: Answers collected during Stage 4 conversational Q&A. Written after each answer, not at the end of the stage.

answer.description: The user's answer, verbatim or lightly paraphrased for clarity

gap_addressed.description: Which gap from Stage 3 this answer closes or partially closes

resume_implication.description: How this answer should be reflected in the resume — new bullet, updated wording, skills addition, etc. Leave blank if not yet determined.

stage5_strategy.description: Approved positioning strategy from Stage 5. Written after user confirms.

core_narrative.description: One sentence: what story does this strategy tell?

emphasizes.description: What to foreground in the resume and cover letter

de_emphasizes.description: What to background or not address directly

stage6_headline.description: Approved resume headline from Stage 6. Written after user explicitly approves.

stage7_summary.description: Approved professional summary from Stage 7. Written after user explicitly approves.

stage9_additional_materials.description: Summary of any additional application requirements identified in Stage 9 and how they should influence the cover letter.

filename.description: Where the completed material was saved, if applicable

cover_letter_implication.description: What the cover letter should not repeat or contradict from this material

stage10_personal_story.description: Personal story or anecdote from Stage 10a, if the user provided one.

story.description: The story or anecdote in the user's own words

placement.description: Where in the cover letter this story should appear — opening, body, or closing
